claims: No engine AI, native collision, chunk loading, save durability or original-game fidelity acceptance is inferred from these tests.

test_names: fresh 12-slot population persists intent before each single birth and survives reload
two-player departure, dimension change, unavailable lookup and return retain exact resident IDs
loaded ID outside every candidate scan still restores only identity metadata
confirmed death leaves a durable tombstone, including failed save and a late removal
legacy empty or partially observed worlds never synthesize missing historical residents
foreign generic trader and town guard cannot suppress or occupy a fresh or legacy slot
legacy Guild tags enroll departed generic spouses without touching relationship or Follow state
unique unmarked named/apprentice campus candidates migrate; excess cohorts remain untouched
definitive slot markers take precedence and duplicate claims never remove or reassign an entity
fresh duplicate slot claims persist a conflict and never create a third resident after reload
one entity cannot use inconsistent metadata to occupy a second fresh slot
initialization and pre-spawn persistence failures perform no native spawn until saved
native spawn exception or missing return handle permanently reserves its intent
a write that persists intent then throws cannot authorize a birth after reload
post-spawn marker and registry failures retain the original ID without another birth
reload after native birth recovers its marker or keeps an unmarked intent reserved
identity-tag failure retries bookkeeping and never emits activity events
corrupt registries, duplicate IDs, unsupported schema and base mismatch fail closed
unloaded/blocked spawn preflight remains retryable before native spawn only
generated Guild gives all 12 homes bounded supported birth centres covering emitted colliders
production preflight refuses missing floors, unknown blocks, headroom, entities and failed scans
actual population enrollment precedes decoration; maintenance and death/load/remove callbacks preserve identity

measurement.method: The real guildResidentSpawnPoint reads cells from gen_structures.build_guild_hall; collider sizes are read from the eight emitted BP resident definitions.
measurement.coordinate_space: Local to fc_guild_base; authored y defaults to 1.
measurement.independent_entities: No nearby entities returned by occupancy query.
measurement.sequential_entities: Earlier birth centers are returned by the real two-block-radius occupancy query in production roster order.

limitations: Unknown historical slots never automatically receive replacement residents; unmarked generic traders and guards cannot be identified by proximity.
Named/apprentice legacy adoption is an inference from current loaded campus observations; provenance cannot reconstruct all old duplicates or summoned residents.
Duplicate claims never remove existing entities; a later single definitive marker can bind an existing claimant without proving others no longer exist.
A native spawn exception or a restart with only unmarked saved intent can leave a slot reserved indefinitely.
There is no atomic Bedrock transaction spanning native birth, entity marker writes and world registry persistence.
Safe birth offset and occupancy refusal are Minecraft adaptations; no existing resident moves and no floor, furniture or headroom is repaired.
Follow owner targeting, Wait random strolling, canonical staff/tutorial roles and in-engine acceptance remain separate open work.
